title: Jellyfish UAP debunked

tellings.quote: it ended up being debunked it it wasn't any it was not a a u UAP

related.note: The same jellyfish UAP video Corbell released, but this speaker claims it was debunked and was not a UAP, which conflicts with the story's account of it as a UFO.

plain: A strange object nicknamed the jellyfish, filed as a UAP (short for unidentified anomalous phenomenon, the official term for a UFO), turned out to be something ordinary after all. That is according to an unnamed speaker in a clip played on the show, who speaks as an official voice and says "it ended up being debunked" and "it was not a UAP." If so, one of the more talked-about objects has an everyday explanation.
